scientific_integrity: The Bessel spectrum of the weighted Volterra limit is an attributed known theorem; the claimed result is the transfer to finite sections and their Hilbert–Schmidt spectral profile.
scientific_limitations: Real 1<alpha<2, fixed rank; no assertion about the full unbounded map, growing rank, critical alpha=2, rates, or independent priority validation.
title: Bessel spectral law for subcritical logarithmic Hilbert-matrix sections
